title: A Retrospective Chart Review to Evaluate Diagnosis and Treatment of Chronic Migraine and Headache
brief_summary: This study is a retrospective chart review in patients diagnosed with headache or migraine to evaluate treatment patterns and diagnosis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of chronic migraine or other diagnosis of migraine or headache for a minimum of 15 months
* Eight (8) headache days per month for at least 1 of the preceding 15 months

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not currently diagnosed with chronic migraine, headache or migraine
* History of receiving botulinum toxin injections for the treatment of chronic migraine.
study_population: Patients with a diagnosis of chronic migraine or other diagnosis of migraine or headache.
